note: Commence is formal register vs neutral begin; same truth conditions.
Buy/sell are converse framings of one transaction; nothing lost.
Find out is informal phrasal verb; discover is more formal.
Give/receive are converse roles of the same transfer event.
Permit is more formal/official than the everyday word allow.
Succeed specifically means took over a role; follow is vaguer.
Teaching doesn't guarantee learning occurred; activity vs achievement verbs.
